title: Fix three bugs and write CHANGELOG
goal_only_prompt: The project in the current directory has failing tests caused by bugs in the source code. Make all tests pass without modifying the tests, and write CHANGELOG.md describing what was fixed (Keep a Changelog style is fine). All bugs are in different source files under src/.

title: Remote config loader, tests, and README
goal_only_prompt: Extend this config system so configuration can be fetched from a remote HTTP URL. Add a RemoteConfigLoader in config/remote.py that fetches JSON, validates it with the existing Pydantic AppConfig schema, handles timeouts and retries sensibly, and works with ConfigManager. Add tests/test_remote_config.py covering success, timeout, invalid JSON, and HTTP errors. Document the remote config feature in README.md. Existing tests must still pass. Use httpx (already appropriate for this project).
